evidence.title: SAE-Xplainers: Rule-Based Feature Interpretation for Extreme Earth Events

summary: A new AI framework, SAE-Xplainers, uses rule-based methods to interpret features in extreme earth events, enhancing scientific understanding. The approach aims to improve explainability in climate and geophysical data analysis.
title: SAE-Xplainers Introduces Rule-Based AI for Interpreting Extreme Earth Events
